title: For each instance display name on host 'blaze8-12' that has system metadata
question: For each instance display name on host 'blaze8-12' that has system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type' (and is not deleted where applicable), return the instance’s average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ROOT_GB along with its VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info JSON, and dense-rank window column partitioned by project_id; then, for each project_id, report the maximum of those per-display-name average ROOT_GB values. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    i.display_name,
    i.project_id,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    iic.network_info,
    i.root_gb
  FROM instances AS i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism
    ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  JOIN instance_info_caches AS iic
    ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND i.deleted = 0
    AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
    AND ism.deleted = 0
),
per_display AS (
  SELECT
    display_name,
    project_id,
    vm_state,
    memory_mb,
    network_info,
    AVG(root_gb) AS avg_root_gb,
    STDDEV(root_gb) AS stddev_root_gb
  FROM base
  GROUP BY display_name, project_id, vm_state, memory_mb, network_info
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    display_name,
    project_id,
    vm_state,
    memory_mb,
    network_info,
    avg_root_gb,
    stddev_root_gb,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY project_id ORDER BY avg_root_gb DESC) AS dense_rank_by_project
  FROM per_display
),
project_max AS (
  SELECT
    project_id,
    MAX(avg_root_gb) AS max_avg_root_gb_per_project
  FROM per_display
  GROUP BY project_id
)
SELECT
  r.display_name,
  r.avg_root_gb,
  r.stddev_root_gb,
  r.vm_state,
  r.memory_mb,
  r.network_info,
  r.dense_rank_by_project,
  pm.max_avg_root_gb_per_project
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN project_max AS pm
  ON pm.project_id = r.project_id

  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'

  SELECT display_name, project_id,

         STDDEV(root_gb) AS stddev_root_gb,
         MAX(vm_state) AS vm_state,
         MAX(memory_mb) AS memory_mb,
         MAX(network_info) AS network_info
  FROM base
  GROUP BY display_name, project_id
)
